product_metadata.title: Portable Mini Humidifier, Small Cool Mist Humidifier with Night Light, USB Personal Desktop Humidifier for Baby Bedroom Travel Office Home, Auto Shut-Off, 2 Mist Modes, Super Quiet, with Adapter
features: ✔️【PORTABLE MINI HUMIDIFIER】- Portable and small design is very easy take with you anywhere and super perfect for travel，bedroom, office, which is effectively moisturize dry skin and help you reduce skin peeling.

✔️【TWO MIST MODES】- This mini humidifier has two modes. When you CLICK the button first time, it will continuously spray for 5 hours. When you CLICK again and it will intermittently spray (stop 2 seconds) for 8 hours. Selecting the mist output conveniently for full control of the air you breathe.

✔️【Top Fill & Easy Control】- This portable usb humidifier is top fill and easy to operate. One button controls for all functions, you simply need to press one button to set the mist and night light. Make your life so easy!

✔️【SAFE & AUTO SHUT-OFF】- There is built-in water level sensor inside that will automatically turn off the power when the water is lower than the safe water level. The Leakproof nano design keep you away from pouring liquid in accidence, NO NEED TO WORRY about your night table / phone / laptop anymore.

✔️【KIND REMINDER】- ① There are 2 replacement cotton swabs included in the package for free.②Do not use distilled water, essential oil, otherwise there might be droplets at the outlet. Please make sure the cotton core has soaked a few minutes before you turning it on. ③Any quality problem, please do feel free to email us.
description: 1.Unscrew the lid gently, fill water into the tank, and then screw the lid. Please use tap water or mineral water. Do not use pure water or steam distillate water, otherwise there will be no fog come out or there will be droplets at the outlet.  2.Let the humidifier stand for 10 minutes to get the cotton stick soaked by water. 3.Use the adapter and USB cable to connect the humidifier to power. 4.
the function key on top of the lid Once for continue spray, Twice for intermittently spray. 5.
the function key for 2 seconds to turn on the 7-color night light, press 2 seconds again to fix the color, press 2 seconds again to turn off the light.
